text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон wins first place in the
Yasuda
Kinen, and things are looking
bright. Everyone is
looking forward to
her future races and her
showdown with
Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But she wants to try taking on another
big race
before the Arima Kinen, and
sets her sights on the
Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
